description: Machine-readable MVP parity matrix for ocis_full capabilities across all deployment outputs. Required by issue #28.

smtp_configuration.label: SMTP Configuration
smtp_configuration.description: Complete mail-delivery configuration with authentication, TLS, and secret management

docker_compose.notes: Password placed in mode-0600 .env file for local secrets

podman_compose.notes: Password placed in mode-0600 .env file for local secrets

kubernetes_helm.notes: Must use pre-created Kubernetes Secret reference, not values. Not rendered in values, Application manifests, logs or downloadable non-secret files

kubernetes_argocd.notes: Must use Secret reference. Must not place secret in spec.source.helm.values

clamav.label: ClamAV Antivirus
clamav.description: ClamAV antivirus service integration with signature management and health checks

kubernetes_argocd.notes: Kubernetes parity missing - requires implementation. Must be semantically identical to Helm

collabora.label: Collabora Office Integration
collabora.description: Collabora office integration with bundled and external modes across all outputs

kubernetes_helm.notes: Currently only external mode available. Bundled option missing and must be explicitly gated until implemented

kubernetes_argocd.notes: Currently only external mode available. Must be semantically identical to Helm

keycloak.label: Keycloak Identity Provider
keycloak.description: Keycloak as selectable identity mode with embedded, bundled, and external options

docker_compose.notes: Only generic external OIDC + LDAP exists. Bundled Keycloak missing

podman_compose.notes: Only generic external OIDC + LDAP exists. Bundled Keycloak missing

kubernetes_helm.notes: Only generic external OIDC + LDAP exists. Bundled Keycloak missing. Kubernetes needs Secret references and persistent volumes

kubernetes_argocd.notes: Only generic external OIDC + LDAP exists. Must reference externally managed/sealed secrets

tika.label: Apache Tika Integration
tika.description: Apache Tika standard and Full variants for content extraction

docker_compose.notes: One implicit Tika Full-style path exists but no standard/full choice

podman_compose.notes: Same as Docker - no standard/full choice

kubernetes_helm.notes: Not explicitly mapped from the selection

kubernetes_argocd.notes: Same as Helm - Kubernetes mapping missing

monitoring.label: Monitoring and Metrics
monitoring.description: Vendor-neutral metrics and tracing configuration with OpenTelemetry support

docker_compose.notes: Placeholder only. Hardcoded monitoring: false behavior must be removed

podman_compose.notes: Placeholder only. Hardcoded monitoring: false behavior must be removed

kubernetes_helm.notes: Missing completely. Profile hardcodes monitoring off

kubernetes_argocd.notes: Missing completely. Must be semantically equivalent to Helm

classic_web_extensions.label: Classic Web Extensions
classic_web_extensions.description: Classic ownCloud web extensions with individual feature controls

ai_branch_extensions.label: AI Branch Extensions
ai_branch_extensions.description: AI/ML extensions from feat/ocis-full-web-extensions-ai branch with proper security boundaries
ai_branch_extensions.note: These features are from an unmerged feature branch. They must be marked Community Preview until individually reviewed and promoted. Availability in the branch alone is not a production-support statement.

fourOutputContract.description: Every MVP capability must have a row with Docker Compose, Podman Compose, Helm and Argo CD implementation status

upstreamDriftControl.description: Alignment catalogue for tracking upstream refs and detecting drift

acceptanceCriteria.description: Full SMTP configuration works across all four outputs
ClamAV works across all four outputs
Bundled and external Collabora behavior implemented or explicitly policy-gated on every output
Bundled Keycloak and external identity modes implemented across all four outputs
Disabled, Tika standard and Tika Full available across all four outputs
Monitoring/metrics/tracing configurable across all four outputs
Advanced Search, Draw.io, External Sites, JSON Viewer, Photo Add-on and Unzip independently selectable across all four outputs
External Sites supports arbitrary number of validated entries and exact CSP generation
Demo content and every named AI/other extension represented and implemented across all four outputs at approved maturity
AI API keys and content never leak into generated repositories, logs or CI artifacts
Every source immutable, licensed, scanned, signed and represented in SBOM/provenance
No production renderer builds from unpinned Git branch or downloads unverified release archive
Dependencies such as Tika, AI proxy, vision model and auth-app fail closed
Helm and Argo CD semantically equivalent
Ansible preserves all selected Compose features and remains idempotent
Issue #26 rejects any untested new option
Upstream drift checks cover master and AI feature branch
Website, Markdown and LLM documentation publish current feature/target/maturity matrix
Final clean commit passes get-owncloud/ci and get-owncloud/full-e2e
